credit_line: Gift of Juan and Anna Marie Hamilton
description: Coat, Black "KNIZE", "Tailored Shirtmaker", 3 scalloped pockets with double flaps. Shawl collar . Heavy wool twill. Handkerchief in breast pocket "Tailor & Shirtmaker.  Label back of neck " Knize New York; London & Paris. Inside proper Left pocket "Knize inc. New York, Paris, Vienna" 7/477 MS. G. O'Keeffe. 3/22/55.  Same date as 0382 pants, different fabric. Five circular plastic buttons on the front; two buttons on each cuff, rounded collar; tapered waist; double scalloped waist pockets; black lining inside coat.  Vienna? Rectangular black tag, in the center rear of the collar, ovular white logo "Knize Taylor shirt maker, New York. London, Paris, Vienna". Inside right front pocket, rectangular white label with black print Knize logo, printed in grey ink. "9/477 Ms. G. O'Keeffe 3/22/55".
title: Coat
